external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Rector, Kazakh National University of Water Management and Irrigation | Expert in Integrated Water Resources Management

Dr Kamshat Tussupova is an expert in water resources engineering and public health, serving as Rector of the Kazakh National University of Water Management and Irrigation. She holds a PhD in Water Resources Engineering from Lund University (2016) and MSc degrees from institutions in Hungary, Kazakhstan, and the USA. Since 2008, she has worked as a researcher at Lund University and was an Expert in WASH Programs for UNICEF in 2020. Dr Tussupova previously served as Vice-Rector of Karaganda Medica
